items.title: At least 6 people killed in shooting at church in Jordan, public security agency says
items.brief: At least six people were killed, and 28 injured, after gunmen opened fire inside a church in Jordan’s Karak province 90 miles south of the capital Amman, Jordan’s public security agency said.

items.title: Melania Trump says she secured a one-city ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine for humanitarian aid
items.brief: First lady Melania Trump announced on Friday that she helped secure a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the city of Oleshky to facilitate the humane evacuation of elderly residents.
